grafica.flautaDet: A vulture-bone flute at Hohle Fels (Germany)
grafica.pitagorasDet: Pythagoras and the octave: music is also mathematics
grafica.guidoDet: Guido of Arezzo names the notes and writes them on lines
grafica.edisonDet: Edison's phonograph: sound can be saved
grafica.lesPaulDet: Les Paul and the eight-track recorder
grafica.midiDet: MIDI: instruments and computers speak the same language
grafica.octava: From one C to the next: twelve keys and twice the vibrations
grafica.compas: The strong beat opens each bar
grafica.forma: The form of Twinkle: the familiar, a surprise and the return home
grafica.tension: Tension and resolution: the home chord ends the story
grafica.rutina: A possible week, fifteen minutes a day

comun.suena: Turn up the volume: this one plays sound.
comun.dominioPublico: Both are in the public domain and play in original arrangements, synthesized in your browser.

onda.la440: The note A: orchestras tune to it
onda.nota: At twice the vibrations, the same note sounds higher.

canciones.titulo: The two songs in this guide

pulso.titulo: The same Ode at another speed
pulso.lento: Slow: solemn, almost a church hymn
pulso.medio: Medium: the pace of a walk
pulso.rapido: Fast: it already makes you want to run
pulso.nota: bpm = beats per minute. The big hit is the first of each bar.

ritmos.nota: Tap the squares to add or remove hits while it plays: each column is a quarter of a beat.

sincopa.cuadrado: Every hit on its beat: correct, but square
sincopa.nota: Syncopation moves an accent to a weak spot, between two beats.

teclado.pasos: The Ode moves in steps: from note to neighboring note
teclado.saltos: Twinkle starts with a leap: from C to G
teclado.nota: Play the keys to try it. Each dot is a note: the higher, the higher the pitch.

acorde.titulo: A chord: three notes at once
acorde.nota: C, E and G: one key on, one key off. Together they make the C major chord.

mayorMenor.titulo: Twinkle in major and in minor
mayorMenor.nota: In minor only two notes change: E drops to E flat, and A to A flat.

progresion.nota: The numbers say which note of the scale each chord starts on. The second one is behind hundreds of pop hits.

mezcla.titulo: Mixer: the Ode in four tracks
mezcla.espectro: Each track in its frequency zone: lows on the left, highs on the right
mezcla.estereo: Where each track sounds, from left to right (easier to hear with headphones)
mezcla.nota: Move each track's volume and panning while it plays, mute one or turn on the equalizer.

minutos.nota: Rough estimate: about 2, 6 or 15 hours per song, depending on how fully you play it.

cierre.titulo: Make music in your own house
cierre.texto: The MindHaOS Audio Studio has it all in a single room: practice songs note by note, create your own with several instruments to play yourself or already produced to listen to, and even mix songs like a DJ on two decks.

paquete.guia: Interactive guide (with a keyboard, a drum machine, major and minor chords, progressions, a four-track mixer and a DJ mix that play in your browser)
paquete.app: Open the Audio Studio in MindHaOS

dj.titulo: DJ mix: the Ode and Twinkle
dj.nota: SYNC matches deck B's speed to deck A's and brings it in on the beat. Then move the crossfader from A to B.
